name: Saeki Kouta
source:
The second chef of Fukujurou.

Kouta is a skilled chef with experience in a variety of cuisines. He is constantly researching and experimenting with new ideas. He specializes in recipes involving incantations. Kouta's mind is always filled with cooking so this causes an inconvenience at times.
